english_hypothesis: Let me pass. I'm walking from here. My brother will bring you the gentleman, Ila, is it? One moment, thank you.

source: ما عمري سمعت هاد العنوان هنايا.
english_gold: I've never heard of this address around here.
english_hypothesis: I have never heard this title here before.

source: أكترية الزناقي ما عندهوم لا اسمية لا رمز. داك الشي علاش اصعيب بزاف باش توصل للوجهة ديالك بهاد العنوان.
english_gold: And most streets do not have names or signs. So it is pretty difficult to get to a destination just by its address.
english_hypothesis: The Zanaga people don't have any names or symbols. That's why it's very difficult to reach your destination with this address.

source: ملي توصل لتما، سول شي حد أخور، عافاك.
english_gold: When you get there, ask someone else, please.
english_hypothesis: Mali reached Tama, a different place, good luck.

source: يمكن ليك اتسول فمكتب الاستعلامات اللي تما، إلا كنتي ضيعتيه.
english_gold: You can ask at that information desk over there, if you get lost.
english_hypothesis: You can beg in the inquiry office, but you are a disgrace.

source: انا كيدا فالبيت سبعة تسعود و عشرين . فيا لوجع بزاف فكرشي . عافاك عيطي ليا على الطبيب.
english_gold: This is Kida in room seven twenty-nine. I have a severe pain in my stomach. Please call a doctor for me.
english_hypothesis: I am the seventh child in the family, twenty-one years old. Oh, the pain is so much in my chest. May God heal you, Atya, for the doctor.

source: واخا، آسيدي. غي تسنا ف الشومبر ديال حتا يجي طبيب.
english_gold: Okay, sir. Please be in your room until the doctor comes.
english_hypothesis: Oh, my dear. Don't worry, the doctor will come soon.

source: وقتاش غادي يجي الطبيب؟
english_gold: When will the doctor come?
english_hypothesis: When is the doctor coming?

source: عافاك اجلس. شنو المشكل؟
english_gold: Please sit down. What's the trouble?
english_hypothesis: You're okay, sit down. What's the problem?

source: عندي حمى خفيفة و عندي أيضا ألم فالصدر فالجانب الأيسر منين كانسعل.
english_gold: I have a slight fever and I also have a chest pain in the right side when I cough.
english_hypothesis: I have a mild fever and I also have pain in the left side of my chest where I was coughing.

source: شناهوا تشخيصك؟
english_gold: What's your diagnosis?
english_hypothesis: Did they diagnose you?

source: غادي نعطيك حقنة.
english_gold: I'll give you an injection.
english_hypothesis: We will give you an injection.

source: واش خاصني نبقى فالفراش؟
english_gold: Do I have to stay in bed?
english_hypothesis: Why are you keeping me in bed?

source: رحلتنا للمشي الطويل المفروض يكون فيها جو بكل.
english_gold: Our hiking trip should be lots of fun.
english_hypothesis: Our mandatory long walk trip should be in the mood of all.

source: اني نحب نمشي.
english_gold: I'm into hiking.
english_hypothesis: I love to walk.

source: اني متحمس، مش قادر نقعمز.
english_gold: I'm so excited, I can't sit still.
english_hypothesis: I'm excited, we can't stay.

source: واو، هدا مكان حلو.
english_gold: Wow, that's a nice place.
english_hypothesis: Oh, this is a sweet place.

source: ايه صح. هدا واحد من مكاناتي المفضله.
english_gold: I agree. It's one of my favorite places.
english_hypothesis: Yeah, that's one of my favorite spots.

source: المنظر حلو. هادو مسارات مليحه.
english_gold: What a view. These are great trails.
english_hypothesis: The view is sweet. They have beautiful paths.

source: الشط لوطا علي طول. منظر يهبل.
english_gold: The beach is right below. What a lovely sight.
english_hypothesis: The shore of Lut along the length. A view of a desolate place.

source: بغيت نعاود لا كارط ديالي.
english_gold: I want to apply for a reissue.
english_hypothesis: I want to reuse my card.

source: فين خصني نقدم طلب إعادة إصدار؟
english_gold: Where should I apply for reissue?
english_hypothesis: Where can I submit a request for reissuance?

source: بغيت نتقدم بطلب لإعادة إصدار.
english_gold: I want to apply for a reissue.
english_hypothesis: I want to apply for a reissue.

source: عندك تقرير البوليس، ياك؟ اشناهوما أرقام التحقق ديالك؟
english_gold: You have a police report, don't you? What are your check numbers?
english_hypothesis: Do you have the police report? Did they give you your verification numbers?

source: اسميتك، رقم بطاقة الائتمان وتاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية؟
english_gold: Your name, credit card number and the expiration date?
english_hypothesis: Your name, credit card number, and expiration date?

source: أكيد. راه ت-ا-ن-ا-ك-ا. رقم البطاقة هو واحد جوج تلاتة ربعة خمسة ستة سبعة تمنية. و تاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية هو شتنبر ألفاين و واحد.
english_gold: Sure. It's T-A-N-A-K-A. The card number is one two three four five six seven eight. And its expiration date is September, two thousand one.
english_hypothesis: Yes. Rah t-anak. The card number is one two three four five six seven eight. And the expiration date is September two thousand and one.

source: غادي تاخد تسعود و تسعين يوم باش تصايب ليك البطاقة. عافاك خلي لينا سميا ديال لوطيل و الرقم فهاد الورقة، باش نقدرو نتاصلو بيك .
english_gold: It will take about ninety-nine days to reissue a card. Please put down your hotel name and telephone number on this paper, so we can contact you.
english_hypothesis: It will take you about ninety days to get the card. Thank you, leave us your name and number on this paper so that we can contact you.

source: اللون مزيان، ولكن القياس ماشي هوا هاداك. تقدر تبدلها من هنا ساعة؟
english_gold: The color is all right, but the size is wrong. Can you have it altered in an hour?
english_hypothesis: The color is nice, but the size is not matching. Can you change it here?

source: واخا، دابا اجيو نديرو طلة عليك.
english_gold: Well now, let's have a look at you.
english_hypothesis: O brother, we have come to see you.

source: هنا راه كبير شوية.
english_gold: Here it's a little too big.
english_hypothesis: There's a big crowd here.

source: الدنيا خاويا هنايا.
english_gold: Here it's a little too loose.
english_hypothesis: The world is a lie.

source: ممكن تزير الخصر بمقدار ثلاثة سنتيمترات؟
english_gold: Could you tighten the waist by three centimeters?
english_hypothesis: Can you reduce the waist by three centimeters?

source: يمكن ليك تقصر الأكمام؟
english_gold: Can you shorten the sleeves?
english_hypothesis: Can I shorten the sleeves?

source: شفت، فهاد الحالة، بلا ما نخلص رسوم التعديل، ياك؟
english_gold: I see, in that case I don't have to pay the alterations charge, right?
english_hypothesis: I saw, so in this case, without finishing the editing fees, right?
